$comment: Third-party packages of the port-only modules, one manifest and one baseline for all of them (src/Vcpkg.props). Each consumer is a feature, installed only when its opt-in property is on: rpgpu (FreelancerRpGpu, docs/re/rpgpu.md). Retail modules never import Vcpkg.props, so none of them sees these packages. builtin-baseline pins vcpkg release 2026.10.16 (SDL 3.4.18).
name: freelancer-port

rpgpu.description: RPGPU.dll, the SDL3 + SDL_GPU render pipeline
